title: BusyIndicator
description: Fiori busy indicator (three pulsing dots) with delay, text and content overlay.

usage.summary: Show that work is running when its completion percentage is unknown.
useWhen: Tell users to wait while an operation runs without a measurable completion percentage.
Limit the busy state to the affected area so users can work elsewhere; wrapped content becomes inert while the indicator is shown.
Use active to signal pending work and delay (1000ms by default) to avoid flashing during brief operations.

avoidWhen.when: A running process has a measured completion value on a 0–100% scale.
No operation is pending and an empty or unavailable area needs an explanation and next step.
